title: Refactor compute() into a dispatch table
description: calc.py implements compute(op, a, b) with an if/elif chain. Refactor it to use a module-level dict named OPERATIONS mapping operation names ('add', 'sub', 'mul', 'div') to two-argument callables, and have compute() look operations up there. Behaviour changes requested together with the refactor: an unknown op must raise ValueError (it used to return None) and 'div' by zero must raise ZeroDivisionError as before. Existing results must not change.
